sources.minimum_moic: 2.0x over a 5-year hold, consistent with the IRR hurdle.
sources.require_base_case_covenant_compliance: No maintenance covenant breach permitted in the base case.

scenarios.name: Base
scenarios.description: Derived from the company's own 10-K: trailing growth fading to 3%, latest-year margins and cost ratios.

scenarios.name: Bull
scenarios.description: Revenue growth 2 percentage points higher each year, gross margin 1 point higher, exit one turn of EBITDA higher.

scenarios.name: Bear
scenarios.description: Revenue growth 4 percentage points lower each year, gross margin 2 points lower, exit 1.5 turns of EBITDA lower.
